invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.19.0 preserves Parts 1–20, the standalone permission-aware shell, focused mobile-safe settings, platform-wide readable light/dark selected states, Kenya eTIMS, international e-invoicing, recurring billing, dunning, portal, payments, credits, retainers and SaMi AI, and adds Part 21 domain hardening: race-safe default dunning seeding plus company-bound foreign-key enforcement across master data, invoices, invoice lines, payments, allocations, refunds, credit notes, retainers, payment plans, recurring billing, reminders, portal records, eTIMS and international e-invoicing. New and updated rows cannot bind a record from another company; clean tenants validate the constraints during upgrade.
